from collections import Counter
import re
# half-count inventory from prior result
inv = Counter({
'the':25,'box':13,'red':6,'blue':5,'contains':5,'green':5,'into':5,'move':5,'and':4,'brass':4,'coin':4,'COLOR':4,'glass':4,'key':4,'marble':4,'silver':4,
'a':3,'boxes':3,'from':3,'of':3,'that':3,'any':2,'are':2,'currently':2,'each':2,'exactly':2,'in':2,'labeled':2,'Next':2,'object':2,'swap':2,'Then':2,'with':2
})
for w in '''add After all At below complete containing contents described determine Do empty entire explain final Finally First Follow format have instructions is label labels line mention moving not objects occurrence on one operations or order other reasoning Replace Reply start steps text these they this three visible When which whichever without You your'''.split():
    inv[w]+=1
guesses = [
'''You have three boxes. At the start, the red box contains a silver key, the blue box contains a brass coin, and the green box contains a glass marble.''',
'''Follow the instructions below in exactly the order they are described.''',
'''After all operations are complete, determine the final contents and visible labels of each box.''',
'''Replace each occurrence of COLOR in the format below with the entire contents of the box with that label.''',
'''Do not explain your reasoning, mention the instructions, or add any other text.''',
'''Reply with exactly one line in this format: red = COLOR; blue = COLOR; green = COLOR.''',
]
used=Counter()
for x in guesses: used.update(re.findall(r\"[A-Za-z]+\",x))
print('NEGATIVE / overused')
print(inv-used & Counter()) # doesn't work
for k in used:
    if used[k]>inv[k]: print(k, used[k], inv[k])
print('\\nRESIDUAL')
res=inv-used
for k,v in sorted(res.items(), key=lambda x:(x[0].lower(),x[0])): print(k,v)
print('remaining',sum(res.values()),'used',sum(used.values()))
